name: Creator programme setup
summary: A brand owner or marketing lead writes the rules for working with creators once, in one file: products and cleared statements, platforms, how creators are paid with the arithmetic behind it, codes, payouts, disclosure, brand safety and roles. Every line is the owner's ruling, marked with its source.

sources.title: The programme setup in Fully Powered AI's Influencer Marketing set (Fully-Powered-AI/influencer-marketing, MIT), with its programme file, its source marks on every line, its per-order deal arithmetic and its rule that the owner rules and the assistant proposes.

sources.contribution: The range of creator deals from a paid post to product only, the four ways of paying a creator, the rule that tracking exists before any content goes live, what a creator is given in place of a script (the reason, a few talking points, the call to action, guardrails), where a disclosure must sit, with the tags that do not count on their own, and the rule that a creator never claims results they have not had or a customer relationship that does not exist, which became the third forbidden line. This file is a copy of the coreyhaines31/marketingskills influencer marketing method, credited separately.

From its spectrum of creator deals and its sections on structuring the deal, disclosure and the run-of-show checklist: the range of deals from a paid post to product only, the four ways of paying a creator (a fee, commission, a fee plus commission, product only), the rule that tracking is set up before any content goes live, and the platform's own partnership label used as well as the written disclosure, never in place of it.

Settling the commission base together with the rate and how long it runs; the terms to decide up front (attribution order, eligible orders, payout hold and threshold); a per-order contribution worksheet.
Separate handling of setting up a new programme and changing one that already runs, which became the first run and the revision run.
The evidence gate: an unsourced field is labelled as unconfirmed and kept apart from established facts, which became the source mark on every line.
Judging a channel by what an acquired order costs against what it earns, with the creator programme as one channel among the store's others.
Deciding which discounts may combine, which became the line on whether creator codes combine with other discounts.

Its store audit of tracking and the installed app stack, which became the ask for the store's live discounts and codes before the programme is set up, and the check that the creator code pattern clashes with no code already in use.
